questions.q: Under which disguise did Ultron first appear in The Avengers #54?
questions.why: Ultron made a cameo as the Crimson Cowl before his full introduction the next issue.

questions.q: Which writer co-created Ultron with artist John Buscema?
questions.why: Roy Thomas wrote Ultron's debut, with John Buscema on art.

questions.q: Ultron is fully introduced in The Avengers #55 as which numbered model?
questions.why: Issue #55 (1968) presents him as Ultron-5, the Living Automaton.

questions.q: Who plays Ultron in Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015)?
questions.why: James Spader played Ultron in the 2015 film.

questions.q: Ultron's body is mainly made of which metal?
questions.why: Ultron's body is mostly adamantium, although some versions use steel.

questions.q: What kind of being is Ultron?
questions.why: Ultron is an artificially intelligent robot that turned on its creator.

questions.q: In which year did Ultron debut in the Avengers comic?
questions.why: Ultron first appeared in The Avengers #54 in July 1968.

questions.q: Which robotic mate did Ultron build using Mockingbird's brain patterns?
questions.why: Alkhema was a robot mate for Ultron, built from Mockingbird's brain patterns.

questions.q: Who wrote the 2013 crossover event Age of Ultron?
questions.why: Brian Michael Bendis wrote Age of Ultron, set in a timeline where Ultron conquers Earth.

questions.q: In which year did Jocasta, Ultron's robotic bride, first appear in The Avengers #162?
questions.why: Jocasta was created for The Avengers #162 in 1977 by Jim Shooter and George Perez.
